files.legend.sop:
@legend.talk core.legend
    namespace=talk
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="The conversation about things: the cards that answers come with and the topics that were talked about"

@talk.chat core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The talk. The world state holds cards (id, kind, title, thing, sentence, data, how), topics (id, name, parent, card, summary) and the current topic."
    example="What does a lighthouse look like?"

@talk.chat.topic core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What shall we talk about?"
files.lexicon.sop:
@lex.talk.sequences core.lexicon
    class=sequence
    doc="Things that come in a fixed order and can be shown on a line"
    word=months
    word=month
    word=seasons
    word=season
    word=days
    word=day
    word=weekdays
    word=planets
    word=planet

@lex.talk.colours core.lexicon
    class=colour
    doc="Colours a card can be changed to by talking (make it red): the shared lexicon of colour names (lex.lang.colour, from k.values)"
    extends=$lex.lang.colour

@lex.talk.listverbs core.lexicon
    class=verb
    doc="The verbs of a listing question (which animals eat grass, which animals live in the sea, which animals can fly): the verb is read as the slot it means in the schemas (eat: eats, live: habitat, can: can)"
    word=eat
    word=eats
    word=live_in
    word=lives_in
    word=live_on
    word=can
    word=cannot
files.operations.sop:
@op.talk.look core.operation
    impl=look
    semantics=action
    action=talk.look
    doc="What is X or what does X look like: one plain sentence and a drawing of X made from its parts (the catalog of drawable things). No fact: I do not know that yet, no card."

@op.talk.parts core.operation
    impl=parts
    semantics=action
    action=talk.parts
    doc="The parts of X or what X is made of: a sentence and a small box diagram of the named parts."

@op.talk.count core.operation
    impl=count
    semantics=action
    action=talk.count
    doc="How many parts of a kind X has: a sentence and that many counted icons."

@op.talk.compare core.operation
    impl=compare
    semantics=action
    action=talk.compare
    doc="Which of two things is bigger, or has more of a part: a sentence and two bars."

@op.talk.order core.operation
    impl=order
    semantics=action
    action=talk.order
    doc="The order of the months, seasons, days or planets from the sun: a sentence and a line with points."

@op.talk.neighbour core.operation
    impl=neighbour
    semantics=action
    action=talk.neighbour
    doc="What comes after or before a month, season, day or planet, or which one is third: a sentence and the line with the point marked."

@op.talk.board core.operation
    impl=board
    semantics=action
    action=talk.board
    doc="What did we talk about: one line per topic, and the topic board shown by the tab."

@op.talk.how core.operation
    impl=howDoYouKnow
    semantics=action
    action=talk.how
    doc="How do you know: the path of the last answer in plain words (the question, what it asks, where the facts came from, the card)."

@op.talk.scope core.operation
    impl=scope
    semantics=action
    action=talk.scope
    doc="What can we talk about: the opening line and suggestion chips taken from the example questions of this world."

@op.talk.change core.operation
    impl=change
    semantics=action
    action=talk.change
    doc="Change the card the conversation is on by talking: a colour, bigger or smaller, or another thing shown next to it."

@op.talk.send core.operation
    impl=send
    semantics=action
    action=talk.send
    doc="Send the card to another tab: the drawing (an object of the drawing), the diagram (boxes), or the map (a place). One step to undo; the answer says which tab took it."

@op.talk.about core.operation
    impl=about
    semantics=action
    action=talk.about
    doc="From a drawing, a diagram or the map: open the Talk tab on the thing that is selected there."

@op.talk.kind core.operation
    impl=kind
    semantics=action
    action=talk.kind
    doc="What kind of thing X is: a sentence and a small tree of its is-a facts."

@op.talk.me core.operation
    impl=me
    semantics=action
    action=talk.me
    doc="What the profile holds about the user: a sentence and a small card. Nothing leaves the device."

@op.talk.drawn core.operation
    impl=drawn
    semantics=action
    action=talk.drawn
    doc="What the user drew in this session: a sentence and a small tally card."

@op.talk.moves core.operation
    impl=moves
    semantics=action
    action=talk.moves
    doc="How many moves the user made in the chess game of this session: a sentence and counted icons."

@op.talk.undo core.operation
    impl=undo
    semantics=action
    action=talk.undo
    doc="Take back the last change of a card or the last transfer to another tab: one step."

@op.talk.other core.operation
    impl=other
    semantics=action
    action=talk.other
    doc="No, the other one: after two things were compared, the conversation moves to the other one of the two and shows it."

@op.talk.ask core.operation
    impl=ask
    semantics=action
    action=talk.ask
    doc="One fact of a thing, whatever world of the knowledge catalog holds it: what colour, what does it eat, where does it live, what is the capital of X. The slot is found through the words of the knowledge schemas; no world is named in this tab."

@op.talk.isa core.operation
    impl=isa
    semantics=action
    action=talk.isa
    doc="Is X a Y: yes or no from the categories of X in the catalog, with what X is when the answer is no."

@op.talk.has core.operation
    impl=has
    semantics=action
    action=talk.has
    doc="Does X have a P: yes with the count when the catalog or the picture says so, no when the count is zero, else what is not known."

@op.talk.view core.operation
    impl=view
    semantics=action
    action=talk.view
    doc="The declaration of Talk as a view of the session things (spec 23): every aspect, one card for each kind of thing."

@op.talk.adopt core.operation
    impl=adopt
    semantics=action
    action=talk.adopt
    doc="Take a thing of the session store into the conversation: a picture when it has a look, a list of what is known otherwise."

@op.talk.list core.operation
    impl=listWhich
    semantics=action
    action=talk.list
    doc="Which K are V (which animals are mammals, which colours are primary, what things are red): the wires of the type the word K means in the schemas, filtered by the slot whose declared values include V. A K that is not a type is a question about one thing."

@op.talk.mix core.operation
    impl=mix
    semantics=action
    action=talk.mix
    doc="What do A and B make (red and blue): the mix facts of the knowledge catalog, in either order."

@op.talk.can core.operation
    impl=canDo
    semantics=action
    action=talk.can
    doc="Can X V: yes when the can slot of the thing (any world of the catalog, the common sense facts) says V, no when its cannot slot does, else what is not known."
files.patterns.sop:
@pat.talk.look.looks core.pattern
    canonical="What does a lighthouse look like?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.whatdoes] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.talk.lookslike] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.look arg.o=\"{o}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="What does a spider look like?"
    example="What does an apple look like?"
    example="What do bikes look like?"
    doc="Frame: what does X look like. The thing is an open slot looked up in the catalog; the answer is one sentence and a drawing of X."

@pat.talk.look.define core.pattern
    canonical="What is a bicycle?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.know.define] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.look arg.o=\"{o}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=4
    example="What is a comet?"
    example="Tell me about the moon."
    example="What is a spider?"
    doc="Frame: what is X (or tell me about X). One sentence and the drawing of X when the catalog has one."

@pat.talk.parts.of core.pattern
    canonical="What are the parts of a house?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.partsof] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.parts arg.o=\"{o}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="What are the parts of a bicycle?"
    example="Show me the parts of a rocket."
    doc="Frame: the parts of X. A sentence and a box diagram of the named parts."

@pat.talk.parts.have core.pattern
    canonical="What parts does a car have?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.whatparts] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.know.have] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.parts arg.o=\"{o}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="What parts does a boat have?"
    doc="Frame: what parts does X have."

@pat.talk.parts.made core.pattern
    canonical="What is a bicycle made of?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [what_is|what_are|what_s|whats] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.know.made] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.parts arg.o=\"{o}\" arg.made=yes"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=10
    example="What is a house made of?"
    example="What is a tree made of?"
    doc="Frame: what is X made of. The material when the catalog says it, and the box diagram of the parts."

@pat.talk.count core.pattern
    canonical="How many legs does a spider have?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.know.count] {p:words(2)} [$lang.know.aux] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.know.have] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.count arg.o=\"{o}\" arg.p=\"{p}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="How many wheels does a bicycle have?"
    example="How many wings does a bird have?"
    doc="Frame: how many P does X have. A sentence and that many counted icons."

@pat.talk.compare.which core.pattern
    canonical="Which is bigger, a mouse or an elephant?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.biggerq] [$lang.know.det]? {a:words(2,noun)} or [$lang.know.det]? {b:words(2,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.compare arg.a=\"{a}\" arg.b=\"{b}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="Which is bigger, Jupiter or Mars?"
    example="Which is taller, a giraffe or a horse?"
    doc="Frame: which of two things is bigger. Two bars."

@pat.talk.compare.than core.pattern
    canonical="Is a dog bigger than a cat?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [is|are] [$lang.know.det]? {a:words(2,noun)} [$lang.talk.compar] than [$lang.know.det]? {b:words(2,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.compare arg.a=\"{a}\" arg.b=\"{b}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="Is Earth bigger than Mars?"
    doc="Frame: is X bigger than Y. Two bars."

@pat.talk.compare.more core.pattern
    canonical="Which has more legs, a spider or a cat?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.hasmore] {p:words(1)} [$lang.know.det]? {a:words(2,noun)} or [$lang.know.det]? {b:words(2,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.compare arg.a=\"{a}\" arg.b=\"{b}\" arg.p=\"{p}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="Which has more wheels, a car or a bicycle?"
    doc="Frame: which of two things has more of a part. Two bars of the counts."

@pat.talk.order core.pattern
    canonical="What are the planets in order?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.seqlead]? [$lang.talk.orderof]? [the|all|our|of_the]? {s:lex.talk.sequences} [$lang.talk.seqtail]? [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.order arg.s=\"{s}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=9
    example="What are the months?"
    example="List the seasons."
    example="What is the order of the planets?"
    doc="Frame: the order of months, seasons, days or planets. A sentence and a line with points."

@pat.talk.after core.pattern
    canonical="What comes after March?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.after] {x:words(2)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.neighbour arg.x=\"{x}\" arg.dir=after"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=10
    example="What month comes after May?"
    example="Which planet is after Mars?"
    doc="Frame: what comes after X on a line of months, seasons, days or planets."

@pat.talk.before core.pattern
    canonical="What comes before Friday?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.before] {x:words(2)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.neighbour arg.x=\"{x}\" arg.dir=before"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=10
    example="Which planet is before Earth?"
    doc="Frame: what comes before X."

@pat.talk.nth core.pattern
    canonical="What is the third planet from the sun?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.nth] [the]? {n:ordinal} {s:lex.talk.sequences} [$lang.talk.seqtail]? [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.neighbour arg.n={n} arg.s=\"{s}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=11
    example="Which is the fifth month?"
    doc="Frame: which one is the Nth of the months, seasons, days or planets."

@pat.talk.nth.which core.pattern
    canonical="Which planet is the third from the sun?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.whichseq] {s:lex.talk.sequences} is [the]? {n:ordinal} [$lang.talk.seqtail]? [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.neighbour arg.n={n} arg.s=\"{s}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=11
    example="Which month is the fifth?"
    doc="Frame: which planet (month, day, season) is the Nth, with the sequence word first."

@pat.talk.other core.pattern
    canonical="No, the other one."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.other] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.other"
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=12
    example="The other one."
    doc="Correction: after two things were compared, the conversation moves to the other one of the two."

@pat.talk.board core.pattern
    canonical="What did we talk about?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.board] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.board"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=11
    example="Show the topic board."
    example="What have we talked about?"
    doc="The board of topics and one line per topic."

@pat.talk.how core.pattern
    canonical="How do you know?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.how] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.how"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=11
    example="How do you know that?"
    example="Where did you learn that?"
    doc="The path of the last answer in plain words."

@pat.talk.scope core.pattern
    canonical="What can we talk about?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.scope] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.scope"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=11
    example="What can I ask?"
    doc="What this tab can talk about, with suggestions."

@pat.talk.it.look core.pattern
    canonical="What does it look like?"
    match="[$lang.connective]? [$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.itlook] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.look"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=12
    example="And what does it look like?"
    doc="Follow-up without a subject: what the current topic looks like."

@pat.talk.it.parts core.pattern
    canonical="What are its parts?"
    match="[$lang.connective]? [$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.itparts] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.parts"
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=12
    example="What are its parts?"
    example="What is it made of?"
    doc="Follow-up without a subject: the parts of the current topic."

@pat.talk.it.count core.pattern
    canonical="How many wheels does it have?"
    match="[$lang.connective]? [$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [and]? [$lang.know.count] {p:words(2)} [$lang.know.aux] [$lang.talk.it] [$lang.know.have] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.count arg.p=\"{p}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=12
    example="And how many legs does it have?"
    doc="Follow-up without a subject: how many parts the current topic has."

@pat.talk.it.compare core.pattern
    canonical="Is it bigger than Mars?"
    match="[$lang.connective]? [$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [is|are] [$lang.talk.it] [$lang.talk.compar] than [$lang.know.det]? {b:words(2,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.compare arg.b=\"{b}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=12
    example="Is it bigger than Earth?"
    doc="Follow-up without a subject: is the current topic bigger than another thing."

@pat.talk.it.compare.bare core.pattern
    canonical="Bigger than Earth?"
    match="[$lang.connective]? [$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.compar] than [$lang.know.det]? {b:words(2,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.compare arg.b=\"{b}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=11
    example="Bigger than Mars?"
    doc="Fragment without a subject: is the current topic bigger than another thing (the same as the question with it)."

@pat.talk.change.colour core.pattern
    canonical="Make it red."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.makeit] [a|more]? {c:lex.talk.colours} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.change arg.c=\"{c}\""
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=14
    example="Paint it blue."
    example="Make this green."
    doc="Change the colour of the card the conversation is on."

@pat.talk.change.bigger core.pattern
    canonical="Make it bigger."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.bigger] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.change arg.size=up"
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=14
    example="Make it bigger."
    doc="Make the card the conversation is on bigger."

@pat.talk.change.smaller core.pattern
    canonical="Make it smaller."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.smaller] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.change arg.size=down"
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=14
    example="Make it smaller."
    doc="Make the card the conversation is on smaller."

@pat.talk.change.too core.pattern
    canonical="Show the moons too."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.showtoo] {x:words(2,noun)} [$lang.talk.too] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.change arg.x=\"{x}\""
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=14
    example="Add the wheel too."
    doc="Show another thing next to the one on the card (or mark one of its parts)."

@pat.talk.send.draw core.pattern
    canonical="Put it in my drawing."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.todraw] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.send arg.to=draw"
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=14
    example="Add it to my drawing."
    doc="Send the card to the Drawing tab: the thing becomes an object of the drawing."

@pat.talk.send.diagram core.pattern
    canonical="Make a diagram of this."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.todiagram] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.send arg.to=diagram"
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=14
    example="Turn it into a diagram."
    example="Make a diagram of this."
    doc="Send the card to the Diagram tab: the parts become boxes linked to the thing."

@pat.talk.send.view core.pattern
    canonical="Show it in the seating plan."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [send|show|put|move|give] [it|this|that]? [to|in|on|into|onto] [the|my]? {to:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.send arg.to=\"{to}\""
    kind=request
    tabOnly=true
    tabClaim=true
    priority=12
    example="Send it to the seating plan."
    example="Show it on the avatar."
    doc="Select the thing of the topic into any other view of the session things (spec 23): the store says what the view can take."

@pat.talk.about core.pattern
    canonical="Ask about this."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.about] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.about"
    kind=request
    signal=true
    priority=14
    example="Talk about this one."
    doc="From another tab: open the Talk tab on the thing that is selected there (the drawing's selected object, the diagram's selected shape, the map's place)."

@pat.talk.kind core.pattern
    canonical="What kind of thing is a comet?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.kindof] [$lang.know.det]? {o:words(3,noun)} [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=talk.kind arg.o=\"{o}\""
    kind=question
    tabOnly=true
    priority=10
    example="What type of thing is a spider?"
    doc="Frame: what kind of thing is X. A sentence and a small tree from the is-a facts of the word senses."

@pat.talk.me core.pattern
    canonical="What do you know about me?"
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|right|also|hi|pls|plz]? [$lang.talk.me] [$lang.tail.filler|i_guess|ish|yes|ya|k]?"

files.world.sop:
@world.talk core.world
    namespace=talk
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.talk
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.kids.common
    formalization=rules
    source="what I know about things"
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Talk about things"
    summary="talk about things"
    tab=talk
    tabTitle="Talk"
    tabAlias=talk
    tabOrder=95
    tabKind=tool
    doc="A chat about things where an answer can come with a small picture made from knowledge, and where the conversation itself is a board of topics. The question frame (what is X, what does X look like, parts of X, how many P does X have, which is bigger, the order of the months, seasons, days and planets) decides the card; the things come from the knowledge catalog by lookup (spec 17) and the picture is drawn from their parts. A plain sentence always comes with a card; no fact means a plain I do not know that yet and no card. How do you know shows the path of the last answer in plain words. Honest scope: the opening line and the suggestions come from the example questions of this world, and a message outside it gets a plain refusal with the two nearest suggestions. State lives in ctx.state (cards, topics, current topic); the Talk tab renders it (spec 18). Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

# Typed needs (sopworld 0.39.0, std.schema.needs): the schemas of the knowledge worlds (the words that mean a slot, the ordered series) are loaded before an operation of this world runs.

    of=talk
    type=core.slot
@need.talk.words std.schema.needs
    of=talk
    type=core.word
